Herb focaccia.text: '''Tip:''' press the dimples all the way down to the tin, otherwise they disappear in the oven.

replies.text: @[[User:Alice|Alice]] Can confirm. My first one looked like a pillow with no dimples at all.

Herb focaccia.text: Does this work with a [[Sourdough starter|sourdough starter]] instead of yeast?

replies.text: Yes, it's in the tips at the bottom. It just takes ''much'' longer to rise.

Herb focaccia.text:
Made it twice this week.
Once with rosemary, once with thin slices of red onion. Both were gone within the hour.
Went ''very'' generous with the olive oil this time and it was the best one yet.
For anyone converting: 500 g of flour is roughly 4 cups, but please weigh it. '''Cups are not reliable for bread.'''

replies.text: Seconded. A cheap kitchen scale changed my baking more than any recipe did.
'''Exactly.''' And it means fewer measuring cups to wash.

Roasted tomato soup.text: Roasted the tomatoes the day before and kept them in the fridge. The soup came together in ''15 minutes'' the next day.
'''Warning:''' don't blend it hot with the lid clamped down. See the tips on the page.

replies.text: Learned this one the hard way too.

Roasted tomato soup.text: Can I leave out the stock and use water?

replies.text:
Yes. Add a little more salt and maybe a spoon of tomato paste.
The roasted garlic carries a lot of the flavour anyway.

Roasted tomato soup.text: Served it with [[Herb focaccia]] on the side. Perfect lunch.
Added a pinch of smoked paprika. ''Highly'' recommended.

replies.text: Let me know how it goes!
